Wrote the docs-check at `public/framework/ai/2026-09-30/pool-taken/docs-check.md` in this worktree (the sandbox wouldn't let me write directly into the monorepo path given in the task — worth merging this over). Summary:

Reclaim happens only when all three hold: holder is stopped/gone in the registry, no live agent still touches the slot, and git is clean with nothing unmerged — checked every 5 min. A taken slot that still holds work is kept forever, no timeout, logged with a reason; getting it back is a manual `--salvage` that preserves the work on an unmerged branch. Makes sense, and the qf-9 incident is real proof the three-condition check earns its keep. Left as open questions: no backstop for a slot a person takes and never returns, "queued to work" is undefined, and nothing says who watches for slots that need salvaging.
